node.title: PROVED (X-11): the h = 2 anchored rung — A_2^nt <= 6n^(5/3)
node.statement: For h = 2 under p >= n^2: split pairs are sum collisions 1 + a = b + c; non-charged forces s = 1 + a != 0; for each of <= n anchors the pairs (b,c) lie on the line b + c = s, whose H^2-points are <= 12 n^{2/3} by the verified Corvaja-Zannier bound (chi = 1, the n^2/p term dead); total A_2^nt <= 6 n^{5/3} (2 n^{5/3} in prime fields via Garcia-Voloch). A real delta = 1/3 rung — 25-29 bits above the trophy at campaign scales, and the proof METHOD (freeze-to-a-curve + CZ) is the template for partial general-h bounds (elementary A_h^nt << n^{2h-3}).
node.notes: X-11 deliverable; verified here (the charged h=2 class is exactly antipodal-sum, matching the census's 992). NOTE: trade sizes start at h = t+1 >= 4 at the campaign rows, so this rung is a template and base case, not a direct consumer input.
